en:
Range Finder

Introduction

The sonar class is used with the Ultrasonic Range Finder, which measures the distance to the nearest object using sound waves. It works by sending out an ultrasonic pulse and measuring how long it takes for the sound to bounce back.

Class Constructor

sonar(
  triport::port &port);

Class Destructor

Destroys the sonar object and releases associated resources.

virtual ~sonar();

Parameters

Parameter Type Description
port triport::port & The first 3-Wire Port of a required two-port group used by the Range Finder. The Range Finder occupies two adjacent ports (A–B, C–D, E–F, or G–H) on either the Brain or a 3-Wire Expander. Specify the first port in the pair (A, C, E, or G), written as Brain.ThreeWirePort.X or ExpanderName.X where X is the port letter (for example, Brain.ThreeWirePort.A or Expander1.C).

Examples

// Create a sonar instance in Ports A and B
sonar RangeFinderA = sonar(Brain.ThreeWirePort.A);

Member Functions

The sonar class includes the following member functions:

  • foundObject — Returns whether the Range Finder detects an object.
  • distance — Returns the distance between the Range Finder and the nearest detected object.

Before calling any sonar member functions, a sonar instance must be created, as shown below:

/* This constructor is required when using VS Code.
Range Finder configuration is generated automatically
in VEXcode using the Device Menu. Replace the values
as needed. */

// Create a sonar instance in Ports A and B
sonar RangeFinderA = sonar(Brain.ThreeWirePort.A);

foundObject

Returns whether the Range Finder detects an object within its field of view.

Available Functions

bool foundObject();

Parameters

This function does not accept any parameters.

Return Values

Returns a bool representing whether the Range Finder detects an object:

  • true — The Range Finder is detecting an object.

  • false — The Range Finder is not detecting an object.

    Examples

// Check if an object is detected.
if (RangeFinderA.foundObject()){
    // Print to screen on the brain that an object was found.
    Brain.Screen.print("object found");
}

distance

Returns the measured distance to the nearest object detected by the sensor.

Available Functions

double distance(
  distanceUnits units );

Parameters

Parameter Type Description
units distanceUnits The unit that represents the distance: inches or mm — millimeters.

Return Values

Returns a double representing the distance in the specified units.

Examples

// Get the Range Finder distance in millimeters.
double value = RangeFinderA.distance(mm);

// Print the current distance detected by the Range Finder to the
// Brain's screen.
Brain.Screen.print(value);
zh:
超声波测距传感器

概述

sonar类与超声波测距仪配合使用，利用声波测量到最近物体的距离。它的工作原理是发出超声波脉冲并测量声音反弹所需的时间。

构造函数

sonar(
  triport::port &port);

析构函数

销毁sonar对象并释放关联资源。

virtual ~sonar();

参数

参数 类型 说明
port triport::port & 测距仪使用的所需二端口组的第一个三线端口。测距仪占用主控器或 3 线扩展器上的两个相邻端口（A–B、C–D、E–F 或 G–H）。指定端口对（A、C、E 或 G）中的第一个端口，写作Brain.ThreeWirePort.X或ExpanderName.X，其中X是端口号（例如，Brain.ThreeWirePort.A或Expander1.C）。

示例

// Create a sonar instance in Ports A and B
sonar RangeFinderA = sonar(Brain.ThreeWirePort.A);

成员函数

sonar类包含以下成员函数：

  • foundObject— 返回测距仪是否检测到对象。
  • distance— 返回测距仪与最近检测到的物体之间的距离。

在调用任何sonar成员函数之前，必须创建一个sonar实例，如下所示：

/* This constructor is required when using VS Code.
Range Finder configuration is generated automatically
in VEXcode using the Device Menu. Replace the values
as needed. */

// Create a sonar instance in Ports A and B
sonar RangeFinderA = sonar(Brain.ThreeWirePort.A);

foundObject

返回测距仪是否在其视野内检测到对象。

函数重载

bool foundObject();

参数

该函数不接受任何参数。

返回值

返回一个bool表示测距仪是否检测到对象：

  • true— 测距仪正在检测物体。

  • false— 测距仪未检测到物体。

    示例

// Check if an object is detected.
if (RangeFinderA.foundObject()){
    // Print to screen on the brain that an object was found.
    Brain.Screen.print("object found");
}

distance

返回到传感器检测到的最近物体的测量距离。

函数重载

double distance(
  distanceUnits units );

参数

参数 类型 说明
units distanceUnits 表示距离的单位：inches或mm— 毫米。

返回值

返回一个double，表示指定单位的距离。

示例

// Get the Range Finder distance in millimeters.
double value = RangeFinderA.distance(mm);

// Print the current distance detected by the Range Finder to the
// Brain's screen.
Brain.Screen.print(value);
